summary: brewer's yeast resolves cleanly to a gluten-free food, so a celiac-relevant gluten source reads as not_detected
evidence: lexicon.json has en:brewers-yeast (aisle baking, traits vg/vt only, no al); traits.json gives it no allergens; FOOD_ALLERGEN_MAP maps no yeast node; allergen.ts text patterns only run on UNRESOLVED lines, so 'brewer's yeast' never reaches the gluten 'malt' pattern either. Brewer's yeast is a beer-brewing byproduct and celiac guidance treats it as gluten-containing unless certified GF; nutritional/torula yeast is not.
